import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 10;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int[][] grid = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        return a >= MOD ? a - MOD : a;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        a -= b;
        return a < 0 ? a + MOD : a;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % MOD);
    }

    static int pow_mod(int a, int n) {
        int res = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) res = mul_mod(res, a);
            a = mul_mod(a, a);
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int inv_mod(int a) {
        return pow_mod(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    static int div_mod(int a, int b) {
        return mul_mod(a, inv_mod(b));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                grid[i][j] = div_mod(val, 100);
            }
        }

        List<Pair<Set<Integer>, Integer>> sets = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pair<Set<Integer>, Integer>> newSets = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<Integer> baseSet = new HashSet<>();
        baseSet.add(0);
        sets.add(new Pair<>(baseSet, 1));

        for (int g = 0; g < n; g++) {
            newSets.clear();
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                int val = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (((mask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        val = mul_mod(val, grid[j][g]);
                    } else {
                        val = mul_mod(val, sub_mod(1, grid[j][g]));
                    }
                }
                for (Pair<Set<Integer>, Integer> p : sets) {
                    Set<Integer> currentSet = new HashSet<>();
                    for (int m2 : p.first) {
                        int possible = (~m2) & mask;
                        while (possible != 0) {
                            int pos = possible & (-possible);
                            currentSet.add(m2 | pos);
                            possible ^= pos;
                        }
                    }
                    if (currentSet.isEmpty()) continue;
                    List<Integer> listCurrent = new ArrayList<>(currentSet);
                    Collections.sort(listCurrent);
                    // Remove duplicates
                    List<Integer> uniqueList = new ArrayList<>();
                    Integer prev = null;
                    for (Integer num : listCurrent) {
                        if (!num.equals(prev)) {
                            uniqueList.add(num);
                            prev = num;
                        }
                    }
                    newSets.add(new Pair<>(new HashSet<>(uniqueList), mul_mod(p.second, val)));
                }
            }
            Collections.sort(newSets, (a, b) -> {
                Iterator<Integer> itA = a.first.iterator();
                Iterator<Integer> itB = b.first.iterator();
                while (itA.hasNext() && itB.hasNext()) {
                    int cmp = Integer.compare(itA.next(), itB.next());
                    if (cmp != 0) return cmp;
                }
                if (itA.hasNext()) return 1;
                if (itB.hasNext()) return -1;
                return 0;
            });
            sets.clear();
            int i = 0;
            while (i < newSets.size()) {
                int j = i;
                int sumVal = 0;
                while (j < newSets.size() && newSets.get(j).first.equals(newSets.get(i).first)) {
                    sumVal = add_mod(sumVal, newSets.get(j).second);
                    j++;
                }
                sets.add(new Pair<>(new HashSet<>(newSets.get(i).first), sumVal));
                i = j;
            }
        }

        int finalAnswer = 0;
        for (Pair<Set<Integer>, Integer> p : sets) {
            finalAnswer = add_mod(finalAnswer, p.second);
        }
        System.out.println(finalAnswer);
    }

    static class Pair<F, S> {
        F first;
        S second;
        Pair(F f, S s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }
}
